ensimmaiset-komennot.title: First commands
ensimmaiset-komennot.goal: First type `help` and press Enter. Then try what the command `git --version` replies.
ensimmaiset-komennot.hint: Type the letters exactly like this: `help`. The second command has a space and two hyphens: `git --version`
ensimmaiset-komennot.success: Great, you’ve run your first commands! This is exactly how the terminal is used: you type an instruction, press Enter and read the answer.

kansioissa-liikkuminen.title: From folder to folder
kansioissa-liikkuminen.goal: Use the command `pwd` to find out which folder you are in. Then move into the Documents folder and look at what’s there. Finally, go back to your home folder.
kansioissa-liikkuminen.hint: You need the commands `pwd`, `cd Documents`, `ls` (or `dir` on Windows) and `cd ..`
kansioissa-liikkuminen.success: Awesome! You can now check where you are, move from one folder to another and look at what a folder contains.

luo-projektikansio.title: A folder of your own
luo-projektikansio.goal: Create a folder called `project` and move into it.
luo-projektikansio.hint: You create the folder with the command `mkdir project` and move into it with the command `cd project`.
luo-projektikansio.success: You created a folder and moved into it. That’s exactly how every new project begins!

projektikansio-harjoitus.title: Project folder ready
projektikansio-harjoitus.goal: Practice before you do the same for real: create a folder `projects` in your home folder, a folder `my-site` inside it, and move into the my-site folder.
projektikansio-harjoitus.hint: The commands in order: `mkdir projects`, `cd projects`, `mkdir my-site` and `cd my-site`. The command `pwd` shows you whether you’ve arrived.
projektikansio-harjoitus.success: Perfect! Next, you’ll do the same in your own terminal.
